claim: Reviewed static fact, not a run of vLLM's code: no file of the pinned vLLM release's serving process (vllm/, csrc/, rust/) names VLLM_ROUTED_DOWN_PROJ_STREAM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD; the result lists the files the scan read. The cut-off the name suggests is a module constant of the Kimi-K3 model file, _ROUTED_DOWN_PROJ_STREAM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD = 256 (vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/model.py:142), not read from the environment, so a stated value reaches no code. At start-up vLLM warns about a VLLM_-prefixed variable it does not list and refuses it only when fail_on_environ_validation is set, which defaults to false (vllm/platforms/interface.py validate_environ, called from EngineArgs.create_engine_config with that flag; vllm/engine/arg_utils.py:863). The constant itself picks whether the router gate and the routed-expert down projection overlap on a second CUDA stream; that is a kernel-level choice of the model's forward, outside what this variable changes. Recorded AgentX runs state the variable as 0.
